description: This source file defines a React component named TenantBootstrapGate that wraps protected routes to ensure the tenant bootstrap logic executes before rendering any nested content. It imports React, the Outlet component from react-router-dom, and a TenantBootstrap component. The component renders TenantBootstrap followed by Outlet to manage routing and ensure initialization logic runs before nested routes.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: React functional component that renders TenantBootstrap and Outlet to protected routes.
